style: Flat vector game background art, cel shaded with flat colour blocks and hard edges, subtle thick dark outline, Chinese ink-and-mineral-pigment mood, limited palette of muted earth and mineral colours, wide cinematic panorama, strong depth by layering silhouettes from dark foreground to pale distance. The distant land occupies only the LOWER HALF of the picture, the upper half is plain open sky. The very bottom edge of the picture is flat ground meeting the horizon. Empty landscape: no characters, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no watermark, no signature, no UI elements.
